🔒 Parent/Caregiver Area

Prototype only. A production version should use real caregiver authentication, consent, secure storage and controlled sharing.

Kya can highlight observable learning and emotional patterns, but does not diagnose learning disabilities, developmental conditions, or mental-health conditions. Concerns should be discussed with qualified professionals.
